pageTitle: Dasara Play Date — Back to Roots

program.title: Dasara Play Mela
program.description: Celebrate Dasara with a fun-filled play date at Back to Roots! Enjoy traditional games, craft activities, and festive treats in a vibrant courtyard setting. Perfect for kids aged 6-12 to experience the joy of Dasara through play and creativity.

items.title: Dasara Circle Time
items.description: An engaging introduction to the Dasara festival, its history and cultural significance through interactive storytelling and visual aids.

items.title: Garland Making
items.description: Learn the traditional art of tying flowers into garlands and decorations, a key element of Dasara celebrations that children can take home.

items.title: Kho Kho Playing Time
items.description: Experience the traditional game of Kho Kho, a popular outdoor activity during festivals that enhances coordination and social interaction.

items.title: Closing Circle
items.description: A calming wind-down session where children reflect on what they've learned, share experiences, and conclude with a simple traditional blessing ritual.
